re_review: Re-review 2026-11-04 (D-SP-4 Stage 3: add spawn_without_inheriting_stdio to susi-windows-runtime): src/lib.rs adds spawn_without_inheriting_stdio (matching crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs in semantics) using direct kernel32.dll extern "system" declarations for GetHandleInformation and SetHandleInformation so susi-windows-runtime retains zero external crate dependencies. Binary targets linked with OS-UCRT (installed_channel and the thin client) call this helper; susi-daemon keeps its library-local copy so msvcrt-linked test harnesses do not pull in platform.rs's atexit symbol. On x86_64/aarch64 Windows MSVC it temporarily clears HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT on non-null stdin/stdout/stderr handles around Command::spawn() and restores the saved bit immediately afterward; non-Windows targets call cmd.spawn() directly. build.rs and src/platform.rs are byte-identical. Re-measured on native x64 Windows with cargo-geiger 0.14.0 by the isolated-package method: used unsafe exposure is 2 unsafe functions (unchanged), 61 unsafe expressions (was 48: the two narrow GetHandleInformation/SetHandleInformation unsafe blocks in spawn_without_inheriting_stdio), and 1 unsafe implementation (unchanged), with 7 safe functions and zero unused unsafe.
